title: OPERATION SHADOW
subtitle: An original campaign
premise: Without warning, the Varn Directorate invades the Kareth Republic. While Private Tomas Halden fights to survive the collapse of the frontier, disgraced intelligence officer Elias Crane hunts the people behind Project TEMPEST - a weapon that turns a regional war into a global one.

missions.title: First Light
missions.summary: A routine dawn patrol becomes the first battle of the war.

missions.title: The Line Breaks
missions.summary: Hold the ridge trenches long enough for the town below to evacuate.

missions.title: Ashfall
missions.summary: Carry a wounded squad mate through occupied streets.

missions.title: No Way Back
missions.summary: Blow the last bridge before the armoured column reaches it.

missions.title: Dead Drop
missions.summary: Recover a courier's data before Directorate agents find him.

missions.title: The Broker
missions.summary: Meet Mira Sol, survive the ambush that follows.

missions.title: Pursuit
missions.summary: Chase the convoy carrying the TEMPEST engineer.

missions.title: Stonewall
missions.summary: Retake the dam before the Directorate floods the valley.

missions.title: Glasshouse
missions.summary: Clear the occupied towers floor by floor.

missions.title: Echoes
missions.summary: Free captured soldiers from a prison camp.

missions.title: Crossroads
missions.summary: Crane's path finally crosses Halden's squad.

missions.title: Fault Line
missions.summary: Break into the fortress at the heart of the conspiracy.

missions.title: Last Light
missions.summary: Stop TEMPEST before it changes the world.
